raw_segments.text: Very easily said, remarked Camilla, amiably repressing a sob, while a hitch came into
her upper lip and her tears overflowed.
Raymond is a witness what ginger and sal volatile I am obliged to take in the night.
Raymond is a witness what nervous jerkings I have in my legs.
Chokings and nervous jerkings, however, are nothing new to me when I think with anxiety
If I could be less affectionate and sensitive, I should have a better digestion and an iron
